original_description: Author an importable Diagramforce diagram from a description, from work already in the conversation, or from an existing diagram the user hands you (a pasted screenshot or whiteboard photo, or a draw.io / Mermaid / other source) - then give them a file to open in the Diagramforce web app (https://diagramforce.mateuszdabrowski.pl). Diagramforce is a no-backend browser editor for Salesforce/CRM architecture, data models (ERD), Data Cloud / Data 360 field mappings, process flows, Salesforce Flows, org charts, Gantt project timelines, and UML sequence diagrams. Use this skill whenever the user wants to VISUALIZE, DIAGRAM, MAP, MODEL, DRAW, or REDRAW/REGENERATE any of those as an editable Diagramforce diagram - especially in a Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, or Data Cloud context - even when they don't name Diagramforce, and INCLUDING recreating an existing diagram they show you. Triggers include "diagram how these systems connect", "turn this into an ERD", "map these Contact fields into the Individual DMO", "visualize this approval process", "document this Flow", "org chart for my team", "gantt for the rollout", "sequence diagram for this API call", "redraw this architecture screenshot as an editable diagram", "convert this Mermaid flow into Diagramforce". It authors diagram JSON validated against the bundled spec, so the diagram imports intact - no account, no backend. Do NOT use it for data charts/graphs or dashboards (bar/line/pie/KPI = data visualization, a different tool), for writing code, or for explaining or reviewing a design without producing a diagram.
